TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT CIIM_ORDR_DTL_STG.PO_NBR, CIIM_ORDR_DTL_STG.ORDR_STS, CIIM_ORDR_DTL_STG.ORDR_TYP, CAST (TO_DATE (SUBSTR((TO_CHAR(CIIM_ORDR_DTL_STG.CPT_TM)),1,9),'DD-MON-YY') AS TIMESTAMP) , CIIM_ORDR_DTL_STG.FACILITY_ID, CIIM_ORDR_DTL_STG.CRT_BY, CIIM_ORDR_DTL_STG.CRT_TM, CIIM_ORDR_DTL_STG.UPD_BY, CIIM_ORDR_DTL_STG.UPD_TM, CIIM_ORDR_DTL_STG.I_U_FLAG FROM CIIM.CIIM_ORDR_DTL_STG where REJECTED_FLAG='N'
